lines.t: I stood among a crowd and made my claim
Vowed I'd never stumble, never hide
I spoke with thunder, calling out your name
With a reckless kind of hollow-hearted pride
I said I'd cast my fears into the sea
As long as you were standing next to me
But the courtyard air grew thin and cold
And I watched the silver turn to gold
I said if I could, and you know I would Follow you straight through the fire
I'll go wherever you need me to go From the peaks above to the canyons below
Oh, right to the edge of the wire
I'll go wherever you go
Then the shadow fell, the questions started flying
And I felt the courage drain out of my soul
Three times I heard my own voice start to lie
While the embers flickered in the charcoal bowl
I found the place where I truly belong
Broken at your feet where you are strong
And the rooster cried against the breaking dawn
And I realized every ounce of strength was gone
But you looked at me, not with rage, but with a light
That led me through the middle of my darkest night
Do you love me? You asked beside the shore
And I don't have to promise forever anymore
I just take your hand
Oh, now I say if I could
Then you know I would
Follow you straight through the fire
I'll go wherever you need me to go
From the peaks above to the canyons below
Right to the edge of the wire
I'll go wherever you go
No more hollow words this time
Just your hand held tight in mine
And wherever you go, I'm finally following you
